summary: Saw lead synth: synthwave, EDM, electro melodies
label: saw lead
body: Melodies and hooks. Square lead (chiptune, 80s): GeneralUser GS/Square Lead; fat: GeneralUser GS/Polysynth.

Register: MIDI 55-91 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Saw Lead, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Saw Lead") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
